title: Existence of a single augmented concrete Godement model
statement: For every scheme $X$ and $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$, there exist a cosimplicial object $A$ and a cochain augmentation $a:F[0]\to K(A)$ such that ModuleCupGodementModel $X,F,A,a$ holds [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model] and ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies $X,F,A$ holds [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies]. Here $K(A)$ is the alternating coface complex extended by zero to integer degrees. Thus the terms, cofaces, codegeneracies and degree-zero germ augmentation are all the concrete monad construction. No flasqueness or quasi-isomorphism is asserted.

source.place: Godement resolution, construction preceding Lemma 20.30.1; Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, §1.1.4, pp. 15–16.

proof.text: The product of the skyscraperHomEquiv equivalences identifies maps from a module F to the product of skyscrapers of a family of stalk modules with families of stalk-linear maps. This gives the stalk/product adjunction. Its endofunctor, unit and multiplication are exactly the product functor, germ unit and multiplication in the cited definitions. The two triangle identities give the unit laws. Evaluating both composites on a stalk representative gives the same value, proving associativity of multiplication.

Put A in degree n equal to T^(n+1)(F). The cofaces insert the unit and the codegeneracies insert multiplication. Naturality of the unit gives the coface/coface relations; associativity gives the codegeneracy/codegeneracy relations; naturality of multiplication and the two unit laws give the mixed relations. These relations extend the assignments to a simplex-category functor using the surjection/injection normal form. They identify the resulting maps with the recursive insertion and collapse definitions.

Naturality of the unit makes the two composites from F to T^2(F) equal. Therefore the germ map into T(F) has zero composite with the first alternating differential. With other components zero it defines a cochain map from F[0], and extension by zero preserves this map. The single-object and extension isomorphisms give precisely the augmentation equality in ModuleCupGodementModel. The identity term equalities witness both model predicates. This argument works unchanged for empty X and zero F.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_models_exist (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
      (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
        (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)),
      ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a ∧ ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X F A
